author: YS-OH-CORE
message:
test(agent): exercise checkpoint policy through real isolated forks

Replace the two helper-level checkpoint assertions in PR #112864 with
two invariants through actual AIAgent construction, cache-parity forks,
forced Hermes compaction, and temporary SQLite session persistence.

The isolated fork must produce a summary while retaining the parent
transcript/session state; a durable agent without a v2 provider must
still fail before a summary call. Only the model boundary returns a
synthetic typed response.

The fork invariant fails with CompressionCheckpointUnavailable on the
exact parent d4720b4e; both invariants and 113 neighboring tests pass
on the original fix at 5bed864c. Product code and original fix
authorship are preserved.

Zero × Youngseok Oh
